## IExtractorLibConfig.program property

Optional: pre-configured ts.Program. If provided, skips compiler setup entirely and uses this program directly.

**Signature:**

```typescript
program?: ts.Program;
```

## Remarks

This is useful when you want to reuse an existing TypeScript compilation across multiple API Extractor invocations.
